Repository URL: https://github.com/SynapseNetworkAI/Synapse-Network-MCP-Server

Category: API Integration

Brief description: Synapse Network MCP Server is a Remote MCP server for AI agents to discover payable APIs, invoke approved paid tools with bounded USDC spend, and retrieve receipts.

Public metadata:
- Website: https://www.synapse-network.ai/
- Docs: https://docs.synapse-network.ai/mcp/paid-api-calls
- Remote MCP endpoint: https://mcp.synapse-network.ai/mcp
- npm package: @synapse-network-ai/mcp-server
- Tools: discover_services, invoke_and_pay, get_receipt
- Auth boundary: BYOK/OAuth connector auth; public listing should not include any raw customer agent credential or API token.

Why it fits Protodex: it is a public GitHub repository that implements Model Context Protocol and gives AI assistants a hosted MCP interface for API discovery, paid invocation with spend controls, and receipt lookup.
title: Add server: Synapse Network MCP Server
